minutes_text:
CITY OF LA VERNE
  FINANCE COMMISSION
  MINUTES OF THE FINANCE COMMISSION OF

  APRIL 22, 2026

  ACTION MINUTES

  "SEE ITALICS"

CALL TO ORDER

Meeting called to order by Chair Simison at 6:30 PM.

ROLL CALL

Finance Commission Members Present: Annabi, Beauchamp, Chan, Riley, and Simison.
Advisory Staff Present: Finance Director Lopez.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

1. Minutes of the Finance Commission on February 18, 2026. Recommendation:
That the Finance Commission approve the minutes of the regular meeting of February
18, 2026.

It was moved by Beauchamp, seconded by Riley, and approved by a vote of 5-0.

DISCUSSION ITEMS

2. High-Level Overview of the 2026 Strategic Plan and Fiscal Year 2026-27 Budget
Direction; Recommendation to City Council on Measure LV Funding Priorities.
Finance Director Lopez provided a high-level overview of the City's Fiscal Year 2026-27
budget development process, Strategic Plan priorities, Measure LV funding priorities,
projected revenues and expenditures, and the long-term financial outlook.

Commission discussion included:

  The City's long-term financial sustainability and structural budget challenges.
  Economic development and commercial property redevelopment opportunities.
  Prioritizing Tier 1 Measure LV expenditures while supporting long-term economic
  development.
  Commercial vacancies, retail recruitment, and attracting new businesses.
  Community education regarding the City's fiscal challenges and budget priorities.
   Partnerships with organizations such as the La Verne Community Foundation and
  local nonprofits.
  Maintaining quality of life while supporting economic growth.

Recommendation: That the Finance Commission review the information presented and
provide an advisory recommendation to the City Council supporting the continued
prioritization of Tier 1 Measure LV expenditures consistent with the City's established
spending guidelines. Additionally, a recommendation to pursue an economic
development company or internal staff member with Tier 2 funds was suggested.

It was moved by Riley, seconded by Beauchamp, and approved by a vote of 5-0.

PUBLIC COMMENT

One member of the public addressed the Commission regarding Measure LV funding
priorities, economic development, support for local businesses, medical emergency
response and ambulance services, and maintaining quality-of-life services. No action
was taken.

STAFF/COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION & INFORMATION

Commission Chair, Simison shared that there is a La Verne Community Foundation
forming which is collaborating with a newly formed Christmas Committee. This
foundation is a non-profit organization which will support community activities.

Other Commission members discussed upcoming community events including the
Fourth of July and upcoming opportunities to engage with the Council regarding the
upcoming budget and opportunities to continue engaging residents regarding the City's
budget priorities. No action was taken.

ADJOURNMENT

The meeting adjourned at 8:21 PM.

The next regularly scheduled meeting of the Finance Commission will be held on August
19, 2026, at 6:30 PM at La Verne City Hall.
